evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/q/d as rs.plugins.pvptracker.PvpTrackerPlugin.
Exact runtime plugin descriptor is title 'PvP Tracker' with config key 'pvptracker'; startup loads pvp_icon.png and attaches a 'PvP Tracker' side-panel navigation entry.
The plugin owns one current fight object plus an ArrayList fight history, clones completed participant/combat state into history, resets the current fight and updates the tracker panel.
The plugin persists a normalized nameFilter through ConfigManager and exposes the current fight, fight-history list and tracker panel to the feature UI.

proposals.note: Source-identified PvP Tracker plugin; exact-v308 UI, state and configuration behavior independently corroborate the recovered source map.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/q/a as rs.plugins.pvptracker.PvpTrackerConfig.
Exact v308 interface extends Config and carries config-group key 'pvptracker'.
Exact config items are fightHistoryRenderLimit ('Max Rendered Fights', Range 1..1000, default 10), exactNameFilter and hidden nameFilter used for panel views.
rs/s/q/d provides this config from ConfigManager, injects it, and uses the same 'pvptracker' configuration key for the PvP Tracker plugin.

proposals.note: Source-identified PvP Tracker config, independently corroborated by exact-v308 config annotations and plugin pairing.
